findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_content · Private data: mobile_checkout_friction_tester, historical_data_drift_estimator · Public sink: impression_share_opportunity_matrix, google_search_impression_share_value_estimator, paid_search_intent_tier_grader, post_ios14_blended_attribution_modeler, total_addressable_market_estimator, customer_expansion_revenue_matrix, competitor_ad_spend_benchmarker, exit_intent_timing_optimizer, video_conversion_modeler, lead_quality_intent_evaluator, request_callback · Destructive: growth_strategy_prioritization_tool, ab_test_significance_calculator, product_tour_effectiveness_grader, sales_pipeline_leak_evaluator, enterprise_contract_discount_evaluator, find_calculator, run_calculator.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_content · Private data: mobile_checkout_friction_tester, historical_data_drift_estimator · Public sink: impression_share_opportunity_matrix, google_search_impression_share_value_estimator, paid_search_intent_tier_grader, post_ios14_blended_attribution_modeler, total_addressable_market_estimator, customer_expansion_revenue_matrix, competitor_ad_spend_benchmarker, exit_intent_timing_optimizer, video_conversion_modeler, lead_quality_intent_evaluator, request_callback · Destructive: growth_strategy_prioritization_tool, ab_test_significance_calculator, product_tour_effectiveness_grader, sales_pipeline_leak_evaluator, enterprise_contract_discount_evaluator, find_calculator, run_calculator

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
